[spoiler=The Holy Militia]
Romariian News Network
---------------------------
Christian Militia Reveals itself to the public.
---------------------------
Recently, a previously unknown Christian militia identifying itself as the Christendom of Romariia has officially revealed its existence after hints from militia members on April 26th.

According to statements released by members of the group, the militia was formed after its founder, John Grobßnes Sion, claimed to have received a divine message from Jesus of Nazareth, calling upon them to free the people of Romariia from sin, corruption, and its enemies.

Despite describing its origins as spiritual and defensive, the group has also openly admitted responsibility for the April 24th burning of the Yoshiland Memorial construction site. According to the militia, the site is a sign of evil and danger for Christians in Romariia.

Since its emergence, the militia has rapidly expanded its presence. Reports from April 27th indicate that the Christendom of Romariia now holds significant control over all of North Nedereland, Imperium Romae Marii City, and parts of west Romariia, which contain the highest concentrations of Imperium Romae Mariis Christian population, a distribution that experts have said to closely align with the militias areas of control.

Witnesses in these regions describe the establishment of checkpoints, patrol groups, and the distribution of Christian materials, alongside increased hostility toward individuals perceived as opposing the groups ideology, especially people from Yoshiland and Muslims, as clashes between Yoshilanders and Christians have recently increased.

Government officials have not yet released a formal response regarding the militias territorial control, as most focus has been redirected to fulfill the ultimatum by Wuloosya, though internal sources suggest that the situation is being closely monitored.

Experts warn that the rise of the Christendom of Romariia represents a major escalation in the nations instability, as it introduces a highly organized and ideologically driven armed faction (after the CDF and Romariian Ordungstaat) into an already fragile political and religious environment, potentially to cause the formation of even more militias. 
[/spoiler]

[spoiler=Mobilization of the Dutch]
Romariian News Network
---------------------------
The government has given weapons to Dutch Citizens for defense.
---------------------------
Recently, the nation, [nation]Nederlandse staat[/nation], has gave the Government a request to mobilize the Dutch Minority of Romariia, although due to its bizarre request, the Government has not seriously accepted it, however, due to the rise of the Christian Militia, CoR in North Nedreland, the government has decided to give weapons to its Dutch Citizens.

The government states that they will give each Dutch citizen above 18:
[list][*]1 AK-47s 
[*]1 R-Glock Mark 3
[*]2 Military Knives
[*] and 3 Safety Kits [/list]

However, the Government states that they will only give these weapons to Dutch citizens who are not mentally ill or over 65 years old, and have no records of crime or radicalism. These weapons are only used for self-defense against militias and terrorists, and maybe criminals as well.

Experts, however, warn that giving weapons to the Dutch Minority may cause the Minority to revolt due to them having weapons to fight.

From: Brother of Mario and Vice President, Luigi Mario

To: President of Yulandburg, Pahinha Balduo

Written on April 23rd, 2028

The Government has formally decided to bring an end to the long-standing Zuiden/Xahu Island dispute that started in 2009.

Imperium Romae Marii will first officially recognize Xahu Island as part of the sovereign territory of the Yussrian Commonwealth Empire of Yulandburg, at April 24, 2028.

After that, all Romariian patrol vessels and military ships currently near Xahu Island will be withdrawn beginning at April 25, 2028.

Given everything happening both in and outside of the nation, we believe this step will be a stepping stone to reducing tensions and avoiding the situation from becoming worse.

We hope this decision can help improve relations between our nations in the future.

From,
Vice President of Imperium Romae Marii, Luigi Mario

[quote=aelthorian_emprie;61715768][b]Aelthorian Empire Declares its Ambition to Become the Sole Hegemon of Shamat[/b]

[i]Pressed before the mighty stage, the proud Empress, newly crowned of a vicious and ostracized polity, stands before a silent crowd of one hundred thousand, clad in the most unrelentingly garish and oppress jet black uniforms, cut through with sharp jabs of crimson red, brought to their full proper dignity of its magnitude. They crowd, shoulder to shoulder, upon endless rows of statues, almost petrified in place if not for the growling ebb of every entrenched gas mask upon the endless rows. Every piece of their kit is entrenched in light armor, yet its gives an illusion of an oppressive power armor, as it every being upon that stage is as unmovable as a statue yet with a ruthlessness to tear from limb to limb. Their eyes utterly unseen and cold beneath their layered helmets.
Everything that surrounds them only takes after brutalist architecture, the endless fortress barreling upon the parade ground, dwarfing even the very presence of those endless crowds who stand beneath it. Above all, standing upon the balcony, there reigned a fiery Empress, her temper umbowed and the sway of her voice reaching a hundreds of thousands, uncowed by even the gravest of their structures and the duty of her office. Behind her the emperor meritus proudly beaming, a vigorous smile upon him, alongside the queen mother maintaining only a professional pose. The vivacious sovereign roars in several chants, each grander than the last, each cutting into silence with the thunder of a hundred thousand voices in unison, rendering any other noise qwenched beneath their bloody toll.
[/i]
"The Aelthorian Emprie shall never end!" [i]Fist[/i]
"[b]Aelthorian Emprie, We will Live to Eternity![/b]"
"The Aelthorian Emprie is the will of the Neko!" [i]Hand on Heart[/i]
"[b]The heart of the neko race lives and dies by us![/b]"
"Aelthorian Emprie is led by one man!" [i]Hand upwards[/i]
[b]"We will serve you now and beyond the grave, Empress!"[/b]

[i]Even the bunkers, towers, and fortresses of Feliarvasta trembled before the sound of her voice and the roars of those who served her. And, with a fiery slam at the podium, a hundred thousand men were silenced. Utter obedience reigned at the stiffening of her form. Even a pin dropping, int this divine and complete cessation, would be heresy. All that remained was the ever present shifts of air exchange, even that being muted by complete repetition. Then, clearing her throat before turning on her microphone, yes just now that was so, she began.[/i]
"50,000 years ago, the Five Heavenly Divine races ruled in perfect harmony and peace. Each of the Divine Races were granted a fifth of the world, with only a remaining sixth granted so that the divine energy of the world would not go fallow should all perish in their duties. The Divine Races were each granted the celestial element by the Creator Deity so that they could each engage with each other in trade to form a complex society. Upon this, the Felixi race was granted the divine energy of amusement, so that they may be joy to themselves and to all the other divine races, and that none would ever be sad again. This order reigned for 30,000 years until all the world was populated with civilizations. However, it was at this point that the divine energy of the world was so perfect it overflowed and brought all the species into the world, creating all the non-humans that exist to this day, and being the origins of all the ancient magics and mechanics. Yet, this meant even the oddest of species would be birthed from the nothingness. There was once such, even," [i]laugh[/i] "a talking race of doors, or a species of sapient goo created by melting lasers that wanted to combine. Yet, it was when the divine energy first collided with the remains of sapient excrement that it breathed into new life, taking the form of a brownish, black goop that slowly learned to walk on two legs, becoming the first proto-man.
"When the Divine Energies of the world were at their peak, man sought to collect as much poop as possible to create more of himself, generating an endless row of variants after variants, using up all of the divine energy in their local region to modify and alter themselves into endless contraptions and mutations. Some humans even began to swim into the ocean, or even to fly like birds. Soon, it became ridiculous, that all other Divine races enacted that they be cut off from the divine energy so that they could take it no more. However, it was only the Felixi that prevented the unanimous vote required to execute them all for their wickedness, for the Felixi were embued with mercy, and they thought that bringing them genuine joy would guide them away from their trickery, so they played many songs by which to tame them, and they proclaimed themselves cured and enjoyed and shared in the divine energy, peacefully engaging with all the other species and becoming great minds.
"However, man is a deceitful race, and when the other races were not looking the twin brothers Samuel and Ahab snuck into the Celestial Storage plane and seized the five cores of divine energy and returned them to the human race. When the 5 Heavenly Divine Races learned of this they attempted to vaporize the humans, but the humans now had access to all the power, and they established a Council of 300 Supreme Wizards by which to govern their hegemony of the entire world. With their wizarding powers they struck down the Heavenly Queens of the Divine Races, putting an end to the primordial harmony. Using their magic, they began a 5,000 year reign of terror, where they slaughtered, murdered, and massacred without end, killing off over 7,000 sapient species from the world. All other sapient species were their slaves and thralls, nothing more than savages they could eat and torture without end for their amusement. They constructed twenty thousand palaces of pure adamantium and used their magic to summon servants from the demon world to ensure their were well comforted. However, without harmony no new Divine Energy could be produced, yet each generation was another generation removed from the exhaustion of the Divine Energy, so they ignored the problem. When any man tried to solve the inevitable crisis they were mocked, exiled to the frontiers of the world, where they devolved their minds so they would not understand shame, and became the monkeys and apes of the modern world. 
"Soon, the humans had ran out of Divine Energy 10,000 years ago, and all went into chaos. First their adamantium palaces collapsed for they could no longer be maintained. Then all their wizarding powers collapsed, leading a rebellion of the un-human, by which they fed them to the demons to maintain their power. However, when the rebellion was ended there was no more Divine Energy to maintain their binds over demon-kind, and they devolved into chaos as the demons conquered the ruins of the world and were now free to spread evil and ensure there would no longer be any harmony in this world. Soon, all of its nature was dead and all the continents were reduced to starving sapients living on dust and demon flesh. Fiery demons reigned down, torturing the humans and other sapients as man had once tortured his fellow sapient. The monsters were uncontested, as the humans did not love the divine and instead cowered in evil and vileness, and thus chose to only source their constructs and servants from the depths of the fiery afterlife.
"The aging Samuel, told his brother Ahab, now King of the humans, realized that humanity could use the fallow field to restore at least some nature to the world. Therefore, as King he led all the humans to the fallow land, for wizards no longer held authority, even as they clung onto their unused spells, which would become all the unnatural forces we could find in this day and age, for they were of another physics unlike our own. Ahab found all the spare divine energy, and he and Samuel wielded it again as the last wizards, forming the world anew, creating the five continents we know today, to match the five divinely granted traits of the Five Heavenly races. Now, the Felixi were in tatters, so they went to the humans asking if they would have mercy and let them in. Samuel, realizing that he was wrong to take all the divine energy away from their rightful masters, allowed the Felixi a place in the new kingdom of the humans, as his servants. However, Ahab was wicked, and his wife Jezebel manipulated him into becoming filled with rage at a supposed betrayal, so Ahab went and hacked Samuel in half in the head with an axe. This terrified all the humans, but their children realized they could kill each other, so from then after the death of Ahab all humans learned to kill each other, and eventually this shattered their one realm into tens of thousands of fragments, each claiming control over the rightful kingdom of Ahab, known as Erene, until the idea of Erene was unified grew futile and eventually faded. The Felixi were enslaved by Ahab and brought before his men as concubines. The ones who reproduced with the humans had the children corrupted by their evil, and they became the kitsunes, canines, and all the other races. Yet, there was only 25% evil in the children of Felixi with the children of Samuel, and there was instead 75% good, so this race became just and righteous before all in spite of their enslavement, and it would be known as the Nekos.
"The nekos then populated the worlds alongside them, oppressed, enslaved, brutalized, and mauled. To the humans nekos were nothing more than specks of dust, pieces of rot that they could abuse to their will. If they knew they were of divine origin, they would become jealous, and they would only serve their cruelties in more tactical and malicious ways. Whenever the nekos founded a state, justice would come to all species regardless of their character, and there would be a rightful and just rule, but the nearby human kings would fear all their subjects would abandon them, so they would justify lies so that they were permitted to crush and slaughter those peaceful realms, a lesson to every neko that they would never let their right to destroy the world go unchallenged. They even invented the philosophy of nihilism, so that any neko who tried to found a better world would be manipulated into thinking that the world was hopeless and inevitably cruel, and that one had to accept the monstrous will of fate, when this so-called fate was really just the obvious cruelty of mankind.
"We nekos are divine, the most pure decedents of the Felixi, were granted a fifth of the world 50,000 years ago, and the time has come again for us to reclaim our birthright. For too long mankind has controlled the Divine Energy, willing it to their cruel self-sadistic ends of eternal warfare with each other and consumption of the world's resources for their wretched vanity. Instead, we will now rebirth this continent in our image. They did not give us much. We live only on the scraps of aluminum in this barren desert the humans did not want, the land the humans gave us because they thought us broken, fallen, destroyed, and most of all, meek. There is much in iron that aluminum does not give, in that is light, that it cannot  but even when it is looked down upon, look upon its great and terrible power!"
[i]A parade of helicopters, of what must have been a thousand of them, each of them clad in pure black and armed to the teeth with enough guns to fund Mizrael for the next thousand years, flying across the parade grounds, with every soldier in the crowd chanting: [/i]
"[b]The Nekos control the skies, the nekos control the skies![/b]"
"Subjects, when aluminum rusts it only gets stronger. The years of torment, slavery, and abuse have only hardened our resolve the rise up and assert our right against the monstrous, barbaric hordes that lay before us, steeling us to a race ready and willing to conquer the continent only to liberate from the wretched control of human governments that know neither sanity or cease, until we came to crush them.
"Henceforth, I re-organizing this regime into The Supreme Final Catgirl State. Because there will be no other states following this, for our regime over shall last over Shamat from this day until all the world decays into dust before the final judgement. Children of Samuel, human scions of Shamat, if you feel the speck of good within your hearts vilified by the evil of this world, submit to our new realm, grant us your resources that we may bring about a better and brighter Shamat, cloaked in only the most pure of divine energies, one that will bring about a true justice for your most rightful ancestor, not cloaked in evil but in the perfection of Felixi governance. Non-humans, rally to us, let our emprie be the one that ends the cycle of destruction, of your misery and ruin at the hands of the humans as we overthrow their wicked states and bring about our great hegemony to Shamat. Join us and honor your divine ancestors, for your blood calls you to something higher and better, a supreme state that rightfully is one with the divine energy that no human reminant will be able to contest!
"Let all who are watching know that the era of man is at an end, and from its ashes Shamat shall become truly aethereal, a beacon of divine harmony from an era thought lost, if only this continent kneels before its sole route to perfection!"
[i]To every government, to every news station by recording created by the Emprie itself, now all may know the claim and plan of the Aelthorian Emprie, and their demands for submission in exchange for a merciful co-existence under a just governance informed by the history of this world. They do not wish to rule as a great power among equals on this continent. They shall take it with their vassals in its entirety.[/i]

There is no doubt that the reunification of Rosenmarkke and Montfleur in the late summer of 2028 led to a massive societal upheaval, splitting history into a pre-union and a post-union world.

Where the pre-union world was driven by the raving madness of the socialist experiments of the mid-2020s, the post-union world came to be a restoration of the classical model of life, at least for the government of the newly created Grande Montfleur.

The people of both countries, however, viewed matters differently. In early September, the triumphant revolution had come to a close, and the citizens of both nations were left with a system that seemed all so foreign to them. Montfleur was used to a quiet and non-aligned life, Rosenmarkke was used to the cosmopolitan technocratic system which had led to rapid growth and rapid centralization. However, the temporary decentralisation of the territories formerly known as Rosenmarkke under the August 11th treaty left many regions which had once seen themselves as brothers of their neighbors questioning and wondering what the hell they were to do.

It was easier for regions like Knygta and Deyn, and Thýven, which had always been bastions of local culture, Belgarde had always leaned towards Montfleurois. However, for Mittlemarkke and Westmarkke, these had shaped the cosmopolitan center of Rosenmarkke and as such were for all intents and purposes, Rosenmarkket but, if the nation existed no longer, what were they? 

Rolfe Rike in The Progression of History, a story of Rosenmarkke and Montfleur, published in 2029.

[b]September 5, 2028: Imperial Ambitions[/b]
Have you heard the rumors out of Valcouerghastly little things these are, but the king intends to declare himself Emperor, stated the voice of one Anna Paolina of Thýven, her petite form wrapped in the most elegant of Montfleurois fashion, her hair pinned back by a diamond family heirloom hairpin.

Of what? Surely he wouldnt claim the East, it would disrupt our neighbors, laughed Colonel Ernst Ralouette, a noble from Montfleur who had become acquainted with Anna Paolina through the various public circles that had formed in the aftermath of the reunification a month earlier. 

I do wonder what these rumors mean, intoned Thomas Lambeau, one of the famed members of the International Association for the Reunification of Rosenmarkke and Montfleur, and the writer of the Declaration of Grievances that had led to the formal reunification.

Well it makes one wonder if re-unifcation was ever a good thing, if we are to be handed from one despot to the next, exclaimed Anna, with a sip of cognac as the swirling ballroom music made its way across the room.

Anna had always been a socialite among the Thývenic society; however, recent years had led to a more austere lifestyle, which she had begrudgingly felt compelled to adopt to ensure she served in the suffering of her fellow citizens. Now, however, that the government had gone away and the future seemed brighter, she had brought out the finery once again. This was the first of many balls she had planned to host, all done up in the old style of the ancien regime to honour the new Montfleurois patrons of the Rosenmarkket region. 

Oh of course not, I am good friends with the king, if Henri tries any funny business, the duchess of Lorrainewho by the way, may I remind you is the actual head of government, will beat him to shape, replied Lambeau. 

Oh, Eleonore, isnt she such a wonderful woman! declared Anna, I would wonder why she isnt queen instead of Henri, 

They did date, it was rumored as a possibility, replied the colonel, leaning and rocking forward on his toes.

Ah, well, what a happy relationship that wouldve been, replied Anna, In fact, another thing I heard, and this from my friend in Valcouer, they are dating again, 

I wouldnt put it past those two, if not for love, but for stability, replied the colonel with a sly grin.

Speaking of love, have you seen the Colletes? I heard Mr. Collete had made love to a maid or some other household servant, said Anna.

Madame Paolina, I do not introduce myself to such hearsay, replied the Colonel, It is unbecoming. 

Oh well, it would be such a drag if the rumor was true, I mean, they are the patrons of the time, billions are coming from their pocket and into the regions most affected by the reunification, replied Anna. 

Oh I heard it was a male maid, shuddered Lambeau.

What?! Exclaimed Anna, I thought he was orthodox? Oh heavenswell, we shant have anymore of that talk, she waved her fan before her, before walking off to speak with the other guests. 

Lambeau looked at the colonel and shrugged, I assume everything is alright with the command? he asked.

Oh yes, General Martel has done a good job at re-organising the forces, replied the colonel.

Well, chortled Lambeau, At least he isnt sleeping with the male maids, 

The colonel laughed, Oh how droll Mr. Lambeau, and I thought you were more behaved than that! 

Lambeau nodded and then wandered the room to speak with the others, leaving the colonel in his uniform, standing in the corner, a glass of champagne in his hand.

The party continued into the night as the revelers made sure to make themselves known to the hostess, whose connections were of great renown. As the night drew to a close, that dainty hostess made her way into the drawing room with the few guests she had discreetly invited for them to meet her aging mother, who was rumored to be the grandest dame in Thýven.

Of course, Lambeau and the Colonel had been roped in, with Anna declaring proudly as she produced the two men, Now see here are the two heroes of this region.

To which Lambeau brushed off the compliment with a laugh, and the colonel merely smiled, he had grown tired and was ready to retire. Unfortunately, the cards had not his retirement from the fête that night, for the arrival of one Madame Eliza Collete (the eldest daughter of the estranged Mr. and Mrs. Collete). 

She was of fine form, draped in a simpler dress which fell to the floor like a pillar, her hair pinned up in pearls, and a set of matching earrings. Upon her arrival, many sought to avoid the scandalous young lady, who had only just been brought out into society the year prior upon her twenty-second birthday, which to many was later than usual. 

Anna, however, was not about to lose the tea of the evening, and as a result, despite the frownings of her mother, made haste to introduce the shy lady to the drawing room and its occupants. 

See here, the lady of the night, clapped Anna with delight, presenting the timid Eliza to her mother, who nodded with a frown.

See there, the shyest of the Colletes it seems, muttered Lambeau with a chuckle.

However, the colonel found himself peculiarly drawn to her, making towards her in the drawing room to provide her his seat, he bowed to her, and taking her hand led her to her seat, Good afternoon madame, he intoned politely, to which she merely smiled.

Is it so that you have drawn yourself to her? mused Anna out loud, moving her fan to cover her mouth.  How scandalous of you, Colonel, she said playfully, tapping his shoulder.

Oh but he doesnt draw himself to scandals madame Anna, declared Lambeau.

I have merely offered a seat, scoffed the colonel, with a pleading look at the whispering guests.

And they say chivalry is dead Anna, intoned the elderly mother with a laugh, The Montfleurois are the ones to bring it back, 

And it was in this manner that the rest of the night continued, silent conversation made between the guests as the band finally wound down, and Anna made haste to shoo those who were not directly within her circle out. 

However, the Colonel and Eliza found themselves out on the sidewalk before the townhouse, the nightlights of the city giving a glow upon their forms as the last of the guests' chauffeurs pulled away. 

Goodbye! cried Anna from the top step of the doorway.

To which the colonel merely nodded and proceeded to turn his attention to Eliza, Have you a car? he asked as she walked down the sidewalk.

No, I shall take the taxi, she replied coolly, her dress sweeping along the ground.

Oh I couldnt allow that, come back to Madame Paolinas house, replied the colonel.

My good sir, if it was my intent to stay at her house I wouldve enquired of her chauffeur, replied Eliza, turning away from the colonel as they stopped on the sidewalk.

Well perhaps you were too shy, replied the colonel.

Nosy is what you are, she replied sharply, beginning to walk again, Now do stop following me or I shall scream, 

The colonel stopped, As you wish, 

Eliza stopped once more, a few paces away, and turned to him, Are you so reluctant to let a lady into the night? she asked.

Well you asked for me to stop following you, scoffed the colonel.

Oh yes, replied Eliza with a wave of her hand, I did, but perhaps I have changed my mind,

The colonel frowned. She was playing a game, a game unbefitting of her, Now maam, let me hail you some more suitable ride, 

No need, replied Eliza, stepping off the curb and waving a taxi down. One noticed her and began to slow down.

Very well, have a good night, madame, replied the colonel as she opened the door and stepped in.

I shall, she replied, slamming the door shut and directing the driver to speed off, leaving the colonel standing on the quiet sidewalk, he stood there for a few minutes before nodding his head and walking off.

[b]September 6, 2028: A miserable morning[/b]

The silence of the Collete house was the most dreadful thing that had come upon the place since the scandal had broken out amongst Thývenic society, staff had been sacked, nannies replaced, and the object of the scandal quietly removed from the house like an unwanted food item. Now, Iosep Collete sat in the early hours of the morning in his office, puffing slowly on his cigar with a glass of bourbon sitting on the desk, undrunk.

His wife and children had gone to his cousin's home for the weekend and were due to arrive back during the day, but his wife did not say. Of course, Iosep did not wish to know when the woman would be back, for she had taken to sighing and looking pale since the scandal broke. 

Thus, he sat at the desk, the papers of the day untouched, the bourbon lukewarm, and the sound of the remaining servants cleaning the house for the arrival of the lady of the house; they paid no attention to the master of the house, nor to his quarters, and as such, they had accumulated a mess of items. 

A knock sounded on the office door as the valet entered the room, an old, doddering man by the name of Viktor who had served the family for three generations and who Iosep had insisted should retire. 

Sir, the morning paper is here, began Viktor, stutteringly.

Send it to the cook, I do not wish gto see it, waved Iosep.

Viktor nodded, and noting that his master was still in his nightgown, made haste to the wardrobe that sat in the office, opening it to produce a clean pair of clothes and a semi-pressed shirt. It is a bit wrinkled, nodded Viktor, moving to hand his master the hangers behind the screen that sat in the room. 

Dressing himself crudely, Iosep stepped out from behind the screen and lit another cigar, When is the lady supposed to arrive? he asked.

Three this afternoon, replied Viktor, Oh, and a donor called, they are worried. 

Tell the donor not to be concerned; all correspondence should be forwarded to my lawyer, intoned Iosep.

Will you be having breakfast? asked Viktor.

No, only grits and some black coffeethe usual, replied Iosep, Eliza came back last night yes? 

Oh yes, she went straight up to her room, replied Viktor.

Is she out today? asked Iosep.

She went out with the nanny to the station, nodded Viktor.

Iosep nodded once more and then sat down, finally sipping the glass of bourbon, I shall have the business brought to me today, but first I must see my wife. 

She is of ill content, replied Viktor worriedly.

I do not care, we have not slept in the same room in three weeks, surely she must be consoled, replied Iosep.

But, the Lawyer began Viktor.

The Lawyer is not married to my wife, snapped Iosep, Now get gone with you, he waved his hand. 

Viktor bowed and made his way out of the office.

Iosep sighed and placed the bourbon glass down, moving to fetch a letter opener he peered at the blade, Oh were this blade in my heart! He thought, placing it down suddenly in horror, What wickedness! He cried aloud, burying his face in his hands.

After a few moments he recomposed himself and went to work on the papers and letters of the day, the majority were the usual, donors, business partners, advertisers, however, one letter was from his great aunt Vita Paolina, who firmly informed him in her writing that she was visiting to set the house in order. 

He checked the date of the arrival, it was that day, dread rose up in his chest as he leapt from his seat and ran out into the hall, Viktor! He called, rushing to find the valet who was in the hall with one of the servants, Why did you not tell me dame Paolina was coming?! he exclaimed.

Sir, I do not read your mail, replied Viktor calmly.

Oh but you didnt recognise the address? Now in my hour of despair, that horrid woman is arriving, on this day?! declared Iosep.

I believe your wife invited her, replied Viktor.

Oh! exclaimed Iosep, So she had decided to make me feel miserably also, 

Sir, I will handle Madame Paolina, please, your study awaits, motioned Viktor, pointing back towards the office. Iosep frowned and replied, I do not wish to see her, keep her out of my sight, he then turned on his heel and walked off to his office.
 
The rest of the day passed for Iosep as a feeling of dread sat upon his chest, he had retired to his study and had sat there unmoving save to use the water closet and to eat a meagre lunch.

He had fallen asleep upon his desk when the grandfather clock in the hall rang three and the sound of voices echoed down the hall, three female voices and the voices of the servants, his wife and two daughters were back, and allegedly, the madame Paolina.

He rose from his desk and moved to the door, opening it he walked into the foyer of the house and caught site of the aunt, a large woman of fine cloth, who gave him a stern look before heading up the stairs.

His heart ached within him as he watched his wife and two daughters disappear from view, why just last year they had gone to the beach together and had such fun.

With a sigh he made his way back into his office, he had changed his mind about seeing his wife.
